name: ros2-intellisense
description: Adds the active ROS 2 package and its dependencies to C/C++ IntelliSense, and builds colcon workspaces.

ros2IntelliSense.rosDistro.markdownDescription: ROS 2 distribution to use (e.g. `humble`, `jazzy`, `rolling`). Leave empty to auto-detect from `ROS_DISTRO`, `.ros-intellisense.env`, `AMENT_PREFIX_PATH`/`COLCON_PREFIX_PATH`/`CONDA_PREFIX`, or `/opt/ros`.

ros2IntelliSense.rosPrefix.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the ROS 2 installation prefix (the directory containing `setup.bash`), e.g. `/opt/ros/jazzy` or a RoboStack/conda environment. Leave empty to auto-detect from the environment and `/opt/ros`.

ros2IntelliSense.compilerPath.markdownDescription: Full path to the compiler used for IntelliSense. Leave empty to use `C_Cpp.default.compilerPath`, then `$CXX`, then a platform default (the C++ driver where available).

ros2IntelliSense.parallelWorkers.description: Number of parallel workers passed to colcon build.

ros2IntelliSense.mineBasePath.markdownDescription: Base path built by the "Build My Packages" command, relative to the workspace. Defaults to `src/<user>`, then `src`, then the workspace root (package-at-root and direct-package layouts).

ros2IntelliSense.extraIncludePaths.markdownDescription: Additional include directories added to every IntelliSense configuration. `${workspaceFolder}` is expanded to the workspace root.

enumDescriptions: Only the active package, its dependencies, the ROS distro and the exact include flags from compile_commands.json (recommended, lightest).
Additionally scan the whole workspace with `${workspaceFolder}/**` (heaviest).
ros2IntelliSense.includeMode.markdownDescription: How much of the workspace is added to the IntelliSense include path.

ros2IntelliSense.enableWorkspaceSymbolSe.markdownDescription: Feed a symbol-search (`browse`) index to the C/C++ extension, covering `src/**` and `include/**` (plus packages kept directly under a repo root). Disable to make the extension even lighter (go-to-definition for resolved headers still works).

ros2IntelliSense.enableConfigurationProv.description: Register a Custom Configuration Provider with the C/C++ extension and select it automatically when no other provider is configured.

ros2IntelliSense.sourceSetupScripts.markdownDescription: Extra setup scripts sourced before `colcon build` (after the ROS installation's `setup.bash` and the workspace `install/setup.bash`).
